/* Made for #WCChallenge 'Flat' hope this counts as flat (See code -------------------------------> :) */                                              let i=0;let n,offset;function setup(){frameRate(1);createCanvas(windowWidth,windowHeight);background('#FA8072');n=windowWidth/350;offset=(windowWidth-floor(n)*350)/2;for(let i=0;i<n-1;i++){plate(175+i*350+offset,windowHeight-300/2,300);}}function draw(){for(let j =0;j<n-1;j++){pancake(175+j*350+offset+random(-20,20),windowHeight-300/2-i*27,random(100,250),25);}if(windowHeight-300/2-i*27<0){i=0;background('#FA8072');for(let i=0;i<n-1;i++){plate(175+i*350+offset,windowHeight-300/2,300);}}else{i++;}}function plate(x,y,w){stroke(40);fill(240);ellipse(x,y,w,w/3);noStroke();fill(220);ellipse(x,y,w*0.85,w/3*0.75);}function pancake(x,y,w,h){fill(40);ellipse(x,y,w+2,w*0.3+2);rect(x-w/2-1,y-h-1,w+2,h+2);ellipse(x,y-h,w+2,w*0.3+2);fill(255);noStroke();fill(255,206,148);ellipse(x,y,w,w*0.3);rect(x-w/2,y-h,w,h);fill(229,171,82);ellipse(x,y-h,w,w*0.3);}function keyPressed(){if(key=='s')save('pancakes.png')}
